    Given a CLEAN numeric string, return a DIRTY version by introducing non-digit characters.

        pos = random.randrange(len(cell) + 1)
        ch = random.choice(nondigits)
        return cell[:pos] + ch + cell[pos:]
    elif op == 'replace':
        pos = random.randrange(len(cell))
        ch = random.choice(nondigits)
        return cell[:pos] + ch + cell[pos + 1:]
    elif op == 'append':
        return cell + random.choice(nondigits)
    else:  # prepend
        return random.choice(nondigits) + cell

    import random
    import string
    import re

    # Pattern for clean values as used by detect()
    clean_pat = re.compile(r'(?:scip-vte-2|scip-inf-(?:4|6)|scip-card-2|ami-(?:1|3|8a)|hf-(?:1|2|3)|pn-(?:3b|7))')

    s = cell if isinstance(cell, str) else str(cell)
    if not s:
        return 'x'

    def is_clean(x: str) -> bool:
        return clean_pat.fullmatch(x) is not None

    # Apply a sequence of random corruptions until a dirty value is produced
    for _ in range(40):
        t = s
        choice = random.randrange(7)
        if choice == 0:
            # insert a random character at a random position
            pos = random.randrange(len(t) + 1)
            ch = random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits + "-")
            t = t[:pos] + ch + t[pos:]
        elif choice == 1:
            # delete a random character
            if len(t) > 0:
                pos = random.randrange(len(t))
                t = t[:pos] + t[pos+1:]
        elif choice == 2:
            # swap two adjacent characters
            if len(t) >= 2:
                i = random.randrange(len(t) - 1)
                lst = list(t)
                lst[i], lst[i+1] = lst[i+1], lst[i]
                t = ''.join(lst)
        elif choice == 3:
            # replace a short segment with random alphanumeric
            if len(t) > 0:
                i = random.randrange(len(t))
                j = random.randrange(i, min(len(t), i + 4))
                repl_len = max(1, j - i + 1)
                repl = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits, k=repl_len))
                t = t[:i] + repl + t[j+1:]
        elif choice == 4:
            # duplicate a character
            if len(t) > 0:
                i = random.randrange(len(t))
                t = t[:i] + t[i] + t[i:]
        else:
            # random case flip of a letter
            if len(t) > 0:
                i = random.randrange(len(t))
                ch = t[i]
                if ch.isalpha():
                    t = t[:i] + (ch.upper() if ch.islower() else ch.lower()) + t[i+1:]

        if not is_clean(t):
            return t
        s = t  # allow next iteration to build on the previous corruption

    # Fallback dirty result
    return s + "-x"
